fields.text:
Presentation design and production services that enable enterprise teams

Williams Lea provides presentation design and production services for organizations managing recurring, urgent, or high-volume presentation demand.

Our presentation specialists combine creative expertise, structured workflows, and purpose-built technology to turn complex information into clear, compelling presentations. From PowerPoint presentations and pitchbooks to client decks, slide formatting, and high-volume production, we help teams deliver polished, brand-consistent work under demanding deadlines.

Benefits to clients

  • End-to-end presentation support – Manages presentation production from initial brief through design, formatting, quality control, and final delivery.
  • Creative expertise at scale – Combines presentation proficiency, structured workflows, and purpose-built technology to manage high-volume demand without compromising quality.
  • Enterprise-grade security and compliance – Supports workflows in highly regulated environments where confidentiality, brand consistency, and quality are critical.
  • Global delivery – Access scalable presentation support across teams and time zones through our 24/7/365 delivery model.

Outsourced presentation support that works with your team

Williams Lea provides outsourced presentation design support for organizations that need ongoing production capacity, additional support during high-demand periods, or specialist expertise for business-critical presentations.

children.question: What are presentation design services?
children.answer: Presentation design services provide specialist support for designing, formatting, and producing business presentations. Our experts can support individual high-priority projects as well as recurring, high-volume presentation requirements.

children.question: What are outsourced presentation design services?
children.answer: Outsourced presentation design services give organizations access to specialist teams that design, format, and produce presentations on behalf of internal teams. Support can range from individual projects to ongoing presentation production.

children.question: What types of presentations can Williams Lea support?
children.answer: Williams Lea supports PowerPoint presentations, pitchbooks, client presentations, presentation formatting, and high-volume production requirements.

children.question: Does Williams Lea provide pitchbook support for private equity firms?
children.answer: Yes, Williams Lea supports private equity and financial services teams with pitchbook and presentation production, including ongoing support for recurring deal-related requirements.

Helping law firms transform legal support operations through AI driven, high-touch global support. With expertise across document processing, administrative assistance, research, billing and financial process and creative solutions, we streamline operations, enhance productivity, and achieve greater flexibility.

fields.text:
Outpacing the competition and improving profitability

A volatile market, increasing client demands, and new market entrants have combined to significantly impact firms' ability to manage growth and maintain or increase profits. The legal market is at an inflection point and firms that don't adapt will cede market dominance.

For more than 30 years, we have helped law firms evolve and revitalize their operations, improve support ratios, automate and digitize processes, enhance the growth potential of their workforce and adapt to changes that have challenged the cultural and institutional norm.

  • Solutions as unique as your firm – We craft solutions that align with each firm's culture, challenges and goals.
  • Global reach, local support – More than 3,000 Williams Lea experts support law firm activities from firm offices or our onshore and offshore delivery centers.
  • Operational rigor and the highest data protection standards – Our operations are ISO 27001 accredited.
  • Service underpinned by technology – Built-for-purpose, AI-first tools such as ENGAGE Service Management, Intake.AI and Deckorate.

fields.heading: Transform your legal support operations today

fields.pageSummary: To meet the expectations of a digital-savvy workforce and clientele, businesses need modern infrastructure, smarter technology, and agile processes. To stay ahead of rapidly shifting market demands, organizations need solutions that remove friction and empower teams to work faster and smarter.

fields.text:
Move to a future-ready support model

Anticipate and evolve with your customer's requirements by putting the right technologies, workflows, and best practices into action. From modernizing mailroom operations to automating record-intensive workflows, we streamline the processes that typically slow teams down.

Our solutions are designed to increase efficiency, strengthen compliance, and create a more responsive, digital-ready environment that flexes with changing demands — connecting data, people, and processes so leaders can make faster, better-informed decisions, optimize resource utilization, and unlock new capacity for growth.

fields.pageTitle: Who Owns the Work When AI Crosses Every Department?
fields.pageSubtitle: A preview of The Convergence Era panel at the Thomson Reuters Institute's 25th Annual Law Firm COO & CFO Forum

fields.text:
By Mike Raposa, Chief Revenue Officer, Williams Lea

Big Law is breaking profit records again. But for how long?

Firms are spending more to run the business, carrying more unbilled work and waiting longer to get paid. AI is supposed to help with all three. So far, the returns are hard to find.

Who owns the work that crosses departments

Law firms have always been organized by department. That works until the deliverable crosses all of them—and real AI workflows do. Each department owns its piece of that chain, and the gains from AI stall at every handoff where ownership stops.

Read the full article on williamslea.com
